annotations.title: Every plan year of one plan: assets, participants, growth breakdown, providers, events

description:
One entry per plan year, oldest first: the filing used, assets and participants, average balance,
approximate return, participant growth (flagged across the 2023 counting change), the growth breakdown
(contributions, investment return, distributions, expenses, transfers), plan-paid expenses and Schedule C
fees in bps, the year's recordkeeper / primary advisor / auditor, and the change events detected that
year.

Price: $0.25 per call, paid in USDC on Base (mainnet) with x402 (MCP transport). Without payment the tool returns the payment requirements. Errors and empty results aren't charged.

Same data as GET /plan/history of the Plan Data API.
